verdict.rationale: The evidence shows LocalAI auto-detects GPU capabilities and downloads a matching backend, and that it ships a first-class CPU path. Nothing in the pack documents diagnostic output, logs or warnings that explain why GPU acceleration failed or that a silent CPU fallback happened. GPU detection is an adjacent feature, not the diagnostics this story asks for.

support.subject: As a power-user, I know why GPU acceleration failed and silently fell back to CPU through clear diagnostic output
